chunks: Faḍālah narrated from Rifāʿah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who does not know whether he prayed one rakʿah or two. He said: “He repeats [the salat (prayer)].”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, a title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates the question posed to the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats; meaning he must perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he prayed one rakʿah or two in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer). If a person is uncertain whether he has performed one rakʿah or two, the ruling given by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام is that he must repeat the prayer.
